text: Guilt, a lot of it. For a long time I'd look at my daughter and remember her face changing. I didn't take anything for over a year. I felt like a bad father and had trouble relaxing when I was alone with her, I'd keep checking on her.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Angst vor großen Männern und vor lauten Stimmen. Wenn jemand neben mir laut wurde, bin ich zusammengezuckt. Ich hatte Albträume von dem Gesicht mit den Hörnern. Ich habe mich auch in Gruppen sehr unsicher gefühlt und konnte nicht mehr meditieren, weil ich dabei die Augen schließen musste und dann das Bild kam. Etwa ein halbes Jahr lang war es sehr schlimm, dann wurde es langsam besser.
Learned to respect both mushrooms and cemeteries, lol. No problems after.

After I left, I fell apart. For months I had flashbacks of the wall, his face, the moment my head hit. They came at night mostly, but also when someone raised their voice or moved suddenly near me. I would freeze completely. I had panic attacks in the shelter and later in our new flat, especially when I heard footsteps on the stairs. I was terrified that he would find us.

I felt split for a long time, like the two people on the sofa. One part of me took care of the kids, went to appointments, talked to lawyers. Another part was watching from far away, numb. My counsellor at the shelter said this is dissociation and that it's common.

I became very depressed in the first year. I felt guilty for staying so long and for exposing my children to him. I felt guilty for leaving. I felt I had destroyed my family. I couldn't sleep properly and I lost a lot of weight.

What's strange is that I also feel grateful to that experience in a twisted way. Without the mushrooms, I don't know if I would have seen him clearly. The clarity scared me, but it also saved me.
Ein paar Tage war ich sehr dünnhäutig und emotional. Danach hatte ich vor allem das Gefühl, dass ich mich selbst besser verstehe und weniger Angst vor dem Tod habe. Ich bin gelassener geworden.

I developed a fear of not breathing. At night I'd wake up gasping and feeling that my chest had stopped. I'd also get a feeling, sometimes during the day, that the white nothing was about to swallow me again. That came with panic. I had depersonalisation in the first couple of months, especially in the evenings.

For about a year after that concert, I had what my psychiatrist called ideas of reference. Songs on the radio, adverts, overheard conversations felt like they were about me, like coded messages. I knew it didn't make sense, but the feeling was very strong. It made me paranoid and anxious. I avoided music for a while, which was horrible because I'm a musician. I also had trouble sleeping and a lot of low mood. I was really scared I was becoming psychotic. It got better slowly.

Ich hatte nach der Rückkehr nach Deutschland monatelang Panikattacken, vor allem nachts, wenn ich allein unterwegs war. Ich habe mich nicht mehr getraut, im Dunkeln allein nach Hause zu gehen. Ich hatte immer wieder das Bild der drei Männer vor Augen und das Gefühl der Hand an meinem Arm. Ich habe mich in Gruppen von Männern unwohl gefühlt und war oft wütend auf mich selbst, weil ich so naiv war. Mein Erasmus-Semester habe ich zwar zu Ende gemacht, aber ich habe mich in den letzten Wochen kaum noch aus dem Wohnheim getraut.

I have big gaps in my memory of those days, which still frightens me. What did I do? Who saw me? I had anxiety and nightmares for over a year, mostly about being tied up and not knowing where I was. I developed derealisation, especially in hot humid weather, which brings back the jungle. I couldn't concentrate at work for months and had to take sick leave. I also felt very foolish and ashamed for going to that place despite the warnings I'd read. For a while I also had a strange problem where I'd sometimes 'see' people in the corner of my eye that weren't there, especially when tired. That went away after about six months.

I became depressed because I felt I'd lost part of my mind. I thought I would never be able to trust my memory again.
Ich habe seitdem Höhenangst, die ich vorher nicht hatte. Schon eine Brücke oder ein Balkon kann mir Herzrasen machen. In die Berge gehe ich nur noch auf breiten Wegen.
A few weeks of feeling uneasy and unsure if I could trust my memory. Stopped hanging out with those friends.
